              that model has data on the day it exists
    tolerance 4 — judgment, 2026-08-21 (M9 P10): no instrument-error evidence exists for the
              OCR path. Launch angle takes _JUDGED_DEGREES's 2 degrees, the claim the other
              two angle fields already make; ball speed takes _JUDGED_YARDS's 5 yards
              through the ~1.4 yd/mph the stored shots show - 5 / 1.4 = 3.6, rounded up.
              That ratio is club-specific; per-club deferred, erring wide

  carry_distance_yds  (yards)

    bias      withheld

              not a number this repo has. Every distribution here is cut from GolfDB, which
              contains no ball flight, and a tour carry band would judge an amateur against
              a population they are not in
    tolerance 5 — judgment, 2026-08-21 (M9 P8): no instrument-error evidence exists for the
              OCR path. 5 yards is below the level a coaching action follows from. The
              correct tolerance is per club and scales with carry; deferred until a per-club
              sample exists, and erring wide until then

  head_sway_norm  (shoulder_widths)
    n = 6 over 6 sessions    target 0.000 +/- 0.060
    bias      yes    center 0.200 (95% CI 0.200 .. 0.200)
